summary: Iteration 10 — Quiz Items (Trivia Klub + Garuda Call) + QUESTIONS array removal. 24/24 backend pytest cases PASS covering public GET filter (trivia / garuda / invalid=422 / missing=422), admin auth gating (401 w/o bearer, 403 non-admin), full CRUD lifecycle (create with/without image, update active hides public but admin sees it, invalid options & answer_index -> 422, image replace returns new URL and file downloadable via /api/files/, soft delete removes from both admin and public lists), category isolation, and regression on /api/app-settings, /api/news, /api/leaderboard, /api/players, /api/scores. Frontend smoke: /category shows 5 cards including testID 'category-garuda' with label 'Garuda Call'; Trivia Klub description updated to 'Tebak gambar seputar klub Laskar Sape Kerap'; starting Classic+garuda with 0 admin items shows empty state with testID 'back-to-category' (no silent null, no Unsplash placeholder faces); after seeding 12 garuda quiz_items the quiz renders Q1/10 with real admin prompt + 4 real admin options.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1924 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into routers (quiz_items, news, matches, etc.) in a future refactor.

GET /api/quiz-items is public but requires `category` query param; a missing category returns FastAPI's generic 422 body (field_required). This is acceptable but not consistent with the custom {detail: 'invalid_category'} shape used elsewhere.
Public GET /api/quiz-items has no limit/pagination; low risk for now but worth adding a limit param if admin seeds many items.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke: 5 category cards incl. Garuda Call, empty-state renders, quiz renders admin content only)

seed_data_creation: During frontend smoke, inserted 12 temporary garuda quiz_items (prompt prefix SEED_Garuda) directly in Mongo to verify the 10-question quiz draws from admin content; all 12 were removed at the end. Backend test fixtures create/clean their own TEST_ users, sessions, and quiz_items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin auth in backend tests is bootstrapped by inserting a user with is_admin=True and a user_sessions row with session_token=<TEST_tok_*> directly in Mongo (see admin_bearer fixture in test_quiz_items.py / test_iter9_settings_news.py). EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is read via dotenv_values on /app/frontend/.env. Comments/likes news endpoints exist in server.py but the frontend UI is intentionally NOT wired yet — only backend sanity is needed if asked.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features behave as specified.
